product: SAP Cloud Identity Services / SAP Cloud Identity Access Governance
version_scope: Current Cloud Identity Services + Cloud IAG — confirm edition wording

claims.text: IAS provides authentication and federation (IdP / proxy patterns such as SAML/OIDC), MFA and related sign-in policy capabilities as documented for Cloud Identity Services.
IPS provides identity provisioning and synchronization (commonly SCIM-oriented jobs, transformations, source/target systems) — not access-request governance.

Cloud IAG provides cloud access governance capabilities (access analysis, access request, certification, privileged access management, role design) distinct from on-premise GRC Access Control MSMP/BRFplus paths.
IAS authenticates; IPS provisions; IAG governs; the target application enforces authorization.
